title: Save a recipe to come back to
userGoal: Keep a recipe I like so I can find it again quickly.
description: On any recipe page the cook taps the heart. The recipe is stored with their account and appears in the Saved list.
outputs: The recipe appears in the Saved list

related.note: Saved recipes are the planner's pick list in the design.

status.note: Saved and reloaded correctly for a signed-in cook. Not checked offline.

evidence.locator: Ran the app; saved 'Lentil soup'; reloaded; it was in Saved.

caption.text: The recipe page lets a signed-in cook tap the heart to add the recipe to their Saved list. Not checked offline.

openQuestions: Should this be called 'Saved' or 'Favorites' in the catalogue?
